artifact_integrity_caveat.detail: Resume scores.jsonl rows verify six-case user metrics, identity and template validity, but do not independently re-check row protocol_sha256 or artifact_sha256 before inserting into cache. import_native_bootstrap skips identities already in that cache. Current imported 48 rows are independently byte-verified here; the gap concerns later recovery after changed/corrupt cached logs/artifacts.

Current imported 48 rows are independently byte-verified here; the gap concerns later recovery after changed/corrupt cached logs/artifacts.

The dry-run maximum_unique_scores uses number_of_phases*scores_per_stage, rather than sum(score_quota), so it overestimates planned capacity when a >=8192 stage has a smaller quota and max-new-scores is above that capacity. Actual scheduling uses phase.score_quota correctly. The present 1536 cap masks this summary discrepancy.
